text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To use it as a foothold for going abroad, 
Sirius Symboli declares she will pursue 
the Classic Triple Crown. Her next goal is 
set on the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep the Classic Triple Crown, and 
ultimately overwrite everything Symboli 
Rudolf achieved in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than a direct confrontation, Sirius 
Symboli intended to surpass her by 
rewriting her race record.
